# fireauth v0.8.0 - Table of Contents

Firebase Auth helpers for Phoenix/Plug (ID token verification + hosted auth helper files)

## Modules

- [Fireauth](https://fireauth.hexdocs.pm/Fireauth.md): Fireauth is a small library for Firebase Auth integration
- [Fireauth.Account](https://fireauth.hexdocs.pm/Fireauth.Account.md): Firebase account management operations via Identity Toolkit.

- [Fireauth.Claims](https://fireauth.hexdocs.pm/Fireauth.Claims.md): Structured representation of Firebase ID Token claims.

- [Fireauth.CustomToken](https://fireauth.hexdocs.pm/Fireauth.CustomToken.md): Adapter interface for minting Firebase custom tokens.
- [Fireauth.EmailLinkSender](https://fireauth.hexdocs.pm/Fireauth.EmailLinkSender.md): Send Firebase email-link sign-in actions from the server.

- [Fireauth.FirebaseUpstream](https://fireauth.hexdocs.pm/Fireauth.FirebaseUpstream.md): Adapter interface for fetching Firebase hosted helper files.
- [Fireauth.FirebaseUpstream.Cache](https://fireauth.hexdocs.pm/Fireauth.FirebaseUpstream.Cache.md): In-memory cache for Firebase hosted auth helper files.
- [Fireauth.FirebaseUpstream.IdentityToolkitPublicKeys](https://fireauth.hexdocs.pm/Fireauth.FirebaseUpstream.IdentityToolkitPublicKeys.md): Caches the public keys used to verify Firebase session cookies.
- [Fireauth.FirebaseUpstream.SecureTokenPublicKeys](https://fireauth.hexdocs.pm/Fireauth.FirebaseUpstream.SecureTokenPublicKeys.md): Caches the Google SecureToken public keys used to verify Firebase ID tokens.
- [Fireauth.HostedController](https://fireauth.hexdocs.pm/Fireauth.HostedController.md): Plug-style controller for Firebase hosted auth callback files.
- [Fireauth.Plug](https://fireauth.hexdocs.pm/Fireauth.Plug.md): Plug middleware that
- [Fireauth.Plug.FirebaseAuthProxy](https://fireauth.hexdocs.pm/Fireauth.Plug.FirebaseAuthProxy.md): Transparent reverse proxy for Firebase hosted auth helper files.
- [Fireauth.Plug.FirebaseInitJson](https://fireauth.hexdocs.pm/Fireauth.Plug.FirebaseInitJson.md): Serve `/__/firebase/init.json` from config.
- [Fireauth.Plug.HostedAuthFiles](https://fireauth.hexdocs.pm/Fireauth.Plug.HostedAuthFiles.md): Serves Firebase authentication helper files with correct MIME types.
- [Fireauth.Plug.SessionCookie](https://fireauth.hexdocs.pm/Fireauth.Plug.SessionCookie.md): Plug middleware that verifies a Firebase session cookie and attaches claims to `conn.assigns`.
- [Fireauth.Plug.SessionRouter](https://fireauth.hexdocs.pm/Fireauth.Plug.SessionRouter.md): Plug that provides endpoints for session-cookie login/logout.
- [Fireauth.ProxyController](https://fireauth.hexdocs.pm/Fireauth.ProxyController.md): Plug-style controller that proxies Firebase hosted auth files to upstream.

- [Fireauth.ServerAuth](https://fireauth.hexdocs.pm/Fireauth.ServerAuth.md): Server-owned OAuth sign-in flow for Firebase / Identity Platform.
- [Fireauth.ServerAuth.SignInResult](https://fireauth.hexdocs.pm/Fireauth.ServerAuth.SignInResult.md): Result returned by `accounts.signInWithIdp`.

- [Fireauth.ServerAuth.StartResult](https://fireauth.hexdocs.pm/Fireauth.ServerAuth.StartResult.md): Provider redirect data returned by `accounts.createAuthUri`.

- [Fireauth.SessionCookie](https://fireauth.hexdocs.pm/Fireauth.SessionCookie.md): Mint Firebase Auth session cookies using a Firebase Admin service account.
- [Fireauth.SessionCookieCreator](https://fireauth.hexdocs.pm/Fireauth.SessionCookieCreator.md): Session cookie creator adapter interface.
- [Fireauth.SessionCookieValidator](https://fireauth.hexdocs.pm/Fireauth.SessionCookieValidator.md): Session cookie validator adapter interface.
- [Fireauth.SessionCookieValidator.Firebase](https://fireauth.hexdocs.pm/Fireauth.SessionCookieValidator.Firebase.md): Firebase session cookie validator.
- [Fireauth.Snippets](https://fireauth.hexdocs.pm/Fireauth.Snippets.md): Small HEEx-friendly snippets for wiring Fireauth client-side flows without
requiring a bundler integration.
- [Fireauth.TokenValidator](https://fireauth.hexdocs.pm/Fireauth.TokenValidator.md): Token validator adapter interface.
- [Fireauth.TokenValidator.Firebase](https://fireauth.hexdocs.pm/Fireauth.TokenValidator.Firebase.md): Firebase SecureToken ID token validator.
- [Fireauth.User](https://fireauth.hexdocs.pm/Fireauth.User.md): Structured representation of a Firebase User derived from ID Token claims.
